nom: Mario Badescu Glycolic Acid Toner with Grapefruit & Aloe

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers describe the toner as generally well tolerated and helpful for controlling shine and breakouts, though a couple note it can still feel a bit drying or paradoxically increase oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it doesn't strip or dry their skin and even helps with dryness, while others report their dry skin became extremely flaky, tight, or burned and had to discontinue use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report improved texture, smaller pores, and balanced oil control, with one noting it still tends to make her skin oily overnight.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report stinging, tingling, redness, or burning especially at first use, though several say it is gentle enough for them long-term if application is kept minimal or paired with moisturizer.
segments.normal: The few reviewers describing normal or normal-sensitive skin report little to no visible effect, neither irritation nor improvement.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers commonly credit the toner with smoother texture, smaller pores, and softened fine lines, though one found it too strong and drying for her fall/winter skin.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers in their 40s-50s report smoother texture, smaller pores, and reduced appearance of fine lines and sun-damage marks; no dissent noted on this concern.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers highlight that it does not leave skin tight or stripped and even helps with dryness, but others describe significant dryness, flaking, or a burning sensation, especially in the first days of use.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers say it reduced redness and irritation over time, while others report immediate tingling, burning, or a rash-like reaction on application.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes a severe reaction with burning, swelling, and rash requiring cortisone and antihistamines, contrasting with many others who report no irritation or barrier disruption at all.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or acne scarring report visible fading or lightening over weeks to months; one reviewer saw no change after two bottles.
concerns.blemishes: The majority of reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report fewer new breakouts, faster healing of existing pimples, and clearer skin over time; one reviewer says it did nothing and one describes it worsening breakouts after overuse.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say it helps balance oil and reduces midday shine, but a few, including one with oily skin, report it made their skin oilier or felt drying despite oil concerns.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels clean and refreshed after use
Large bottle lasts a long time for the price
Contains parabens and alcohol in formula

extraits.titre: I would NOT buy this again
extraits.texte: I never use toner because I have very dry skin but I wanted to try to add something into my skin care routine so I decided to try this one since I've loved all the mario badescu products I have used in the past. I thought the ingredients would not irritate my skin because of the aloe and other ingredients in it that i have used before. After a few days of using this, my skin became extremely dry and flaky and would burn so bad every time I washed it or put other product on. My skin is still recovering right now, after trying to just intensely moisturize i eventually had to turn to cortisone ointment and benadryl to help the burning and itching sensation, which has seemed to help turn my skin back to normal. I don't normally have sensitive skin but if you do I would not recommend trying this!!!

extraits.titre: Perfect if you don't use too much
extraits.texte: This is definitely my go-to toner. I've been using it for a year or two now. The thing that I've learned though is if you have more sensitive skin like I do, you have to keep the application to a minimal. Like only a couple drops onto a cotton ball or else it might irritate your skin. But other than that it's really helped improve my acne and it doesn't make my skin oily or dry and it's super refreshing to apply.

I love this toner. I'm so glad someone at Ulta recommended it to me. It helps keep my acne away and helps to get rid of those old scars. Fair warning, I have oily skin and even this is a little drying for me. So do not use it you have dry sensitive skin. Also be careful to not apply even close to your eyes. It kinda has the same effect as sunscreen and can irritate your eyes.

I've tried countless toners in the last 5 years none impressed me until now. It's as if this was the missing puzzle piece in my skin care regimen. My skin looks so different, way more even tone and texture. I never want to stop using this! Start slow ppl! I started with ever other night for a few weeks, then every night, now I use this almost every morning and night. When my skin is feeling extra dry I do take a break. Remember this does serve as a chemical exfoliator. I have dry, sensitive, acne scarred skin, plus hormonal acne once in a while. This stuff works soo well for me.

extraits.titre: Great even for my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: My skin has become acne prone as of Feb. 2020 and I struggled for a long time trying to get my skin care routine down. This toner was recommended to me and it's been amazing (actively using for 2.5 months now). My skin is sensitive and dry. While the toner is slightly on the drying side, with a great moisturizer, it'll be no problem at all.

I have dry, sensitive skin, partly oily, some pimpels, a lot pores and first, not so small anymore, wrinkles. This toner is gentle and leaves my skin super clean, refreshed and brightened. I use it for a week now and I got not a single new pimple, my pores seem smaller and old acne wounds and scars begin to disappear. My skin does not feel dry after use! Love it!

I waited a month to post a review because I wanted to see if this toner actually worked like other reviewers said and guess what, IT DOES! I am a 50 yo medium light olive skin woman with not only hyperpigmentation spots on my nose but also Melasma on my cheeks. This toner in a month has completely changed/lightened my spots on my nose. They went from dark brown to barely there. As for my cheeks anyone with Melasma knows that it is very hard to treat/get rid of and I am turning to prescription hydroquinone to help my discoloration. As for this toner it smells refreshing, feels cool/fresh on the skin and for the price you get a huge bottle. Bonus for me is that it works without drying out my skin.
